statement: SDL pinned at 535d80b reads feature 0x20 bytes 44-45 as little-endian firmware_version; for 0x0224 and later, it enables improved compatible rumble using valid-flag2 bit 0x04 and full amplitude; below 0x0224, older valid-flag0 bit 0x01 is used and amplitudes are halved. SDL at 829a65d separately caches enhanced_rumble on Sony Edge, unknown version 0, or firmware >=0x0224. Linux instead tests update_version >= version 2.21 for base DualSense, while Edge always uses v2.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: SDL 535d80b 427-432, 683-700; SDL 829a65d 434-447, 719-733; Linux 1150-1176, 1796-1810. The synthetic 0x0224 selects SDL improved-rumble path; no source indicates it is universally mandatory or an authentic physical revision.
